```yaml
name: E2E Tests (Playwright)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-e2e:
    name: Playwright E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox

      - name: Build packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: Start website examples
        run: yarn website:examples
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Wait for server to be ready
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3456 > /dev/null; then
              echo "Server is ready"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for server... ($i)"
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: yarn test:e2e
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

  test-nextjs-e2e:
    name: Next.js E2E Tests (Playwright)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      matrix:
        router: [app, pages]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox

      - name: Build packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: Run Next.js E2E tests (${{ matrix.router }} router)
        run: yarn test:e2e:nextjs:${{ matrix.router }}
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report-nextjs-${{ matrix.router }}
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
```
